description:
A Forgejo user, in one of three modes:

- **external** — `loginSourceId` set: the account is pre-provisioned
  against an authentication source (e.g. Authentik over OIDC) and linked
  on the person's first login. No password.
- **local** — no `loginSourceId`: a random password is generated and
  written to `secretTargets`. With `bot: true` the password is generated
  and never stored anywhere: nobody can use it, and the account works
  only through its tokens and SSH keys.
- **observed** — `managementPolicy: Observe`: the user is never created,
  modified or deleted, only resolved by `username` so other CRs can
  reference an account Forgejo auto-created at OIDC login.

bot.description:
Service account: its password is random and never emitted, so it is
only usable through `ForgejoAccessToken`s and `ForgejoUserKey`s.
(Not `prohibitLogin`: Forgejo refuses a prohibited account's API
tokens too.)

deletionPolicy.description:
Defaults to `Orphan`: deleting the CR keeps the account and the
attribution of everything it authored. Users are never purged.

instanceRef.description:
The `ForgejoInstance` or `ForgejoLocalInstance` this object lives
on. Unset: the cluster's only `ForgejoInstance`, else the only
`ForgejoLocalInstance` of this namespace.

kind.description: The kind of instance a reference designates.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace only applies to kind LocalInstance

loginName.description:
Identity of the account at the authentication source (for OIDC, the
`sub` claim or the configured username claim). Defaults to
`username`. Only used with `loginSourceId`.

loginSourceId.description:
ID of the Forgejo authentication source (Site administration →
Authentication sources) the account logs in through. Forgejo has no
API to list sources, so this is the numeric id, not its name.

managementPolicy.description: Whether the operator owns the Forgejo object or only looks it up.

prohibitLogin.description: Disable the account entirely — web, git and API tokens alike.

restricted.description: Restricted users only see what they are explicitly granted.

secretTargets.description:
Where the generated password of a local, non-bot user is written
(`FORGEJO_USERNAME`, `FORGEJO_PASSWORD`, `FORGEJO_URL`). Required for
those users; ignored otherwise. A target deleted later triggers a
password reset, since the old value can't be read back.

items.description:
Where an emitted secret (generated password or key, OAuth2 credentials,
access token) is written. A CR may list several targets — the same
value is fanned out to each.

backend.description:
`kubernetes` (default) or `vault`. A Vault target reuses the Vault
connection (address, mount, auth) the instance configures, which it
must then do.

name.description:
Kubernetes: the `Secret` name. Vault: names the default path
`<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/<name>` when `path` is unset.

namespace.description:
Kubernetes `Secret` namespace (Vault: the namespace segment of the
default path). Defaults to the CR's own namespace; required on
cluster-scoped CRs. A namespaced CR may only name its own namespace.

path.description:
Vault only: explicit KV v2 path under the instance's mount. It must
stay under `<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/` (this object's namespace, or
the target's on a cluster-scoped object), unless the instance's
`pathGrants` open it to this object.

sharedWith.description:
Other namespaces allowed to reference this object (when the operator
enables cross-namespace references). Unset: this namespace only.

clusterScoped.description: Cluster-scoped objects may use this instance.

namespaceSelector.description:
Namespaces whose labels match this selector may use this instance.
An empty selector (`{}`) matches every namespace: the instance —
and the token it holds — is then shared with the whole cluster.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description: A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values. Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description: values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn, the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist, the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic merge patch.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

namespaces.description: Namespaces whose objects may use this instance.

username.description: Forgejo login. Changing it renames the account in place.

visibility.description: Visibility of a Forgejo user or organization.
